fields.description: International Trade Show on Plastics & Printing & Packaging. Now in its 8th edition plastprintpack Ethiopia 2026 retunrs to Addis Ababa, showcasing the impressive growth and vast potential of Ethiopia's plastic, printing and packaging sectors. Organised by fairtrade Messe in cooperation with local partners Prana Events, the exhibition will bring thousands of industry professionals from Ethiopia and around the globe, making it a must-attend event for anyone in the future of plastics, printing and packaging in the region.
